Team,

Recommended offer (initial proposal):
- Title: Senior ML Engineer (IC) — L5

2) Are we comfortable with the proposed base vs. our 2028 anchor bands (see attached chart)?
3) Any immediate risks for acceptance if we keep L5 IC wording?

Subject: Re: SEN-237 — candidate summary and proposed band

Marissa — thanks for the note and the context. Quick thoughts:

- Title: I lean toward Senior ML Engineer (IC, L5) given panel feedback and candidate preference. Manager title would require clear people lead responsibilities and we didn't see direct people management signal.
- Comp: $210k base is slightly above our L5 anchor midpoint but within range for SF-market hires. If we want to preserve budget for cluster-level hires, consider $205k base + $20k sign-on split over 4 quarters.
- Acceptance risk: candidate is currently at GreenTech on a smaller equity package; the equity grant cadence matters more than a small base delta. Recommend increasing LTIP (equity) vs. base to hit acceptance without changing banding.

I'm available 11:45 — let's hop on a quick call with Jonas to validate comp levers.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Talent & HR Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks team — ran the numbers against the new 2028 comp bands. TL;DR: L5 IC at $205–220k base is appropriate; equity target would be 0.12%–0.18% (4-year vest, 1yr cliff).

Notes:
- If we label title as L5 (Senior) IC, comp authority stays with central comp for offers up to $220k base; above that requires GC sign-off.
- If we promote to a manager title without direct reports, it complicates alignment vs. role expectations. We should avoid manager title unless candidate will own 1:many mentorship + direct reports within 6 months.
- Proposed offer revision: base $205k, signing $20k (paid 50/50 across two quarters), equity 0.15% (grant value ~ $40k at 2028 strike assumptions), target bonus 12%.

Attached: SEN-237-offer-draft.pdf (edit for wording and title).

Happy to approve if Marissa confirms candidate preference for IC and we finalize comps.

—Jonas
